import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
# Column AQ (index 42) is English learner 2021-22
col_aq = 42
tx_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Texas')].index[0]
ca_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('California')].index[0]

ca_rate = float(df.iloc[ca_row, col_aq])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_graduation_rates_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 219.46', header=None)
# Rows 7 to 57 are states and DC (Excel rows 8 to 58)
state_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 15]].copy()
state_df = state_df[~state_df[0].astype(str).str.contains('District of Columbia')]
state_df[15] = pd.to_numeric(state_df[15], errors='coerce')
top3 = state_df.sort_values(by=15, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(x).strip() for x in top3[0].tolist()]
